_source.remarks.text.0: 仅当 `ruleType` 为 {@link EPCB_PrimitiveRegionRuleType.FOLLOW_REGION_RULE} 时有效，用于匹配区域 DRC 规则

title: Set the property state: region name
remarks.text.0: Only valid when `ruleType` is {@link EPCB_PrimitiveRegionRuleType.FOLLOW_REGION_RULE}, used to match region DRC rules
remarks.text.1: If `ruleType` is {@link EPCB_PrimitiveRegionRuleType.FOLLOW_REGION_RULE} but `regionName` is empty, the system will automatically assign a name
